svg.aria-label: The pull request step: you approve and QualityLayer opens the pull request on GitHub and follows its checks and reviewers. When a thread, a request for changes or a failing check arrives, it waits in Your turn; your agent goes through it with you and you push the fix. You merge the pull request yourself, and the task closes
